summary: The uniqueness scaffolding (`lipschitzOnWith_mul_sq` plus the compact-interval bound in `IsOneLoopRGSolution.ne_zero`) re-derives `bkRhs_lipschitzOnWith`/`bkSolution_unique_on_Icc` from the sibling module `Evolution/SmallX.lean`, whose scalar instantiation `SmallXSystem ℝ` is already used there; and `SmallX.not_exists_global_solution_sq` is now a special case of the new `IsOneLoopRGSolution.add_landauLogScale_notMem` but keeps its own 40-line separation-of-variables proof. Everything else (the solution, Landau log-scale/scale API, asymptotics, `IsOpen.exists_Icc_subset`) is new and reuses upstream API.
